title: [BUG] Unexpected CLI Symbol Underlining Persists Across Restarts
body:
**Bug Description**
Ocasioanlly all of the symbols in CLI become underlined. Not critical but annoying and doesn't go away with restarting with --continue argument. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: gnome-terminal
- Version: 1.0.25
- Feedback ID: d28134b2-bb26-48fd-bb00-37f2b0ca4bee
